scene: Atop the roof, three transit lines await passengers over the neon cityscape.
picture: A flat side view along a high rooftop transit deck. On the far left sits a yellow flying scooter. In the centre, the grandmother in pink tracksuit stands with her white dog on a lead. To the right hovers an open double-decker bus, and on the far right floats a striped drone gondola.
shown: a sleek yellow flying scooter parked on a launch rail on the far left
a red double-decker hover bus hovering with open doors on the right
a striped gondola suspended under a buzzing giant drone on the far right
